# Example: main.cpp + the Tree/ AST & interpreter, built against synparser.
# Ast.gen.h is generated by hand (python generator/gen_ast.py) and lives in this
# directory, so add it to the include path.
file(GLOB TEST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Tree/*.cpp)

add_executable(test_example ${TEST_SOURCES})
target_link_libraries(test_example PRIVATE synparser)
target_include_directories(test_example PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

foreach(DATA_FILE tokens.txt input.txt lang.syn)
    add_custom_command(TARGET test_example POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${DATA_FILE}
            $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:test_example>/${DATA_FILE}
        COMMENT "Copying ${DATA_FILE} next to test_example")
endforeach()
